quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results: revenue RMB1,034.6 million, up 207.2% year-on-year; gross profit RMB557.0 million, up 210.8%, with gross profit margin 53.8% (up 63 bps vs 2024). R&D expenses RMB1,476.1 million, up 78.5%, reflecting investment in next-generation products and technology. Loss for the year RMB16,493.0 million, driven by finance cost - net of RMB15,451.2 million from the increase in the fair value of redemption liabilities granted to pre-listing investors (terminated upon listing); adjusted loss for the year (non-IFRS) RMB873.8 million (RMB767.3 million in 2024). Other income rose 189.6% to RMB289.6 million, primarily due to an increase in government grants.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue RMB1,034.6 million (+207.2%); gross margin 53.8%; adjusted loss RMB873.8 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 revenue mix: sales of intelligent computing solutions rose 205.1% from RMB336.8 million to RMB1,027.7 million, primarily due to at-scale volume production and shipment of the BR10X series flagship GPGPU products, delivery of multiple thousand-card-scale intelligent computing clusters and expansion of high-quality clients. Other revenue: entrusted R&D services RMB4,631 thousand, rental income from intelligent computing clusters RMB1,414 thousand, support / extended warranty RMB914 thousand. Cost of sales rose 203.0% to RMB477.6 million (cost of semiconductors, tooling and software testing). Inventories and consumables used RMB705,288 thousand (2024: RMB148,676 thousand); intellectual property license expenses RMB58,773 thousand (2024: RMB4,726 thousand).
quarterly_data.figure: Intelligent computing solutions revenue RMB1,027.7 million (+205.1%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Deployments (Chairman's report, CEO Wen Zhang): in 2025 Biren completed volume production and commercialization of its GPGPUs BR106 and BR166 across all form factors and crossed into thousand-card-scale cluster deployment. It delivered several multi-thousand-card-scale intelligent computing cluster projects, with clients ranging from national-level intelligent computing centers and telecom operators to commercial AI data centers (AIDC), AI / LLM companies and enterprises; the clusters achieved 'minute-level resumption of training from breakpoint'. Software: Day-0 / rapid adaptation of DeepSeek V3/R1, MiniMax M2, Zhipu GLM, Alibaba Qwen, StepFun Step and Tencent Hunyuan models; support for PyTorch, vLLM, SGLang, Triton and TileLang on its BIRENSUPA software stack.
quarterly_data.figure: BR106 and BR166 in volume production; multi-thousand-card cluster projects delivered in 2025

quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical SuperPod: built on the BR10X series, Biren launched with ecosystem partners the 'LightSphere X' SuperPod solution using optical interconnect and distributed optical circuit switching (dOCS), aimed at overcoming the bandwidth-density and energy-efficiency limits of electrical interconnect. A 2,048-card GPU SuperPod cluster with optical interconnect and the dOCS solution has been deployed at a national-level intelligent computing center; the company says it will continue to advance optical interconnect in future product generations.

quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Next generation: the BR20X product series is planned for commercial launch in 2026, with upgrades in compute density, memory capacity and bandwidth and interconnect, and dedicated FP8/FP4 engines; BR20X will introduce SuperPod cluster solutions based on Biren's proprietary Blink 2.0 interconnect protocol, supporting scale-up to thousand-card-scale clusters, compatible with mainstream SUE protocols, multiple southbound switches and in-network computing, aimed at large-scale MoE expert parallelism.
quarterly_data.figure: BR20X planned for commercial launch in 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Strategy (Chairman and CEO Wen Zhang): R&D will incorporate advanced packaging and multi-chiplet integration, deepen SuperPod system innovation toward clusters of 10,000-card and beyond, and keep investing in optical interconnect and advanced liquid cooling; the company aims to become a 'leading computing system solution provider' (chip + system + ecosystem) and to secure supply through strategic partnerships, diversified sourcing and technology synergy, calling supply-chain safety of strategic importance to China's AI chip companies. CEO: workloads are shifting from training to inference and demand from single-GPU peak performance to system-level efficiency.

quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partnership: in 2025 Biren formed a strategic alliance with StepFun, Shanghai Yidian AI Computing Services and other partners to establish the 'Domestic AI Joint Laboratory', a Chip-Model-Cloud ecosystem aimed at reducing per-token cost for AI applications through co-optimization of hardware and algorithms.

quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer and supplier concentration, FY2025: the largest customer accounted for approximately 19.1% of revenue (2024: 54.5%) and the five largest customers 71.3% (2024: 90.3%); five customers each contributed over 10% of revenue - Customer A RMB197,562 thousand, Customer B RMB181,867 thousand, Customer C RMB125,386 thousand, Customer D RMB122,563 thousand, Customer E RMB110,751 thousand (unnamed). The largest supplier accounted for approximately 29.1% of purchases (2024: 32.0%) and the five largest suppliers 57.7% (2024: 58.9%).
quarterly_data.figure: Largest customer 19.1%, top five 71.3% of FY2025 revenue; largest supplier 29.1%, top five 57.7% of purchases

quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Balance sheet at December 31, 2025: inventories RMB948.6 million, held to address accelerating customer demand and ensure supply-chain resilience; gross trade receivables RMB532.3 million (up 508.3%) on increased project deliveries and rapid fourth-quarter revenue growth, with RMB302.3 million (56.8%) collected by the date of the Chairman's report; liquidity RMB2,822.7 million; capital commitments RMB58.0 million (property, plant and equipment and intangible assets); 842 employees. The H shares were listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on January 2, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Inventories RMB948.6 million; capital commitments RMB58.0 million
